description.value: The Civic Centre is a public community facility in downtown Nelson, BC, tagged in OpenStreetMap as a community centre at 305 Hall Street. It is operated under the Regional District of Central Kootenay's recreation portfolio alongside other community complexes in the region. Touring cyclists passing through Nelson may find it a useful landmark, but specific services for cyclists have not been confirmed.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: bollard (2 spaces) at 71m; bollard (2 spaces) at 99m; shed (covered, secure) at 100m. Total: 4 spaces.
